knowledge.textEn: Estimate plane-of-sky speed from synthetic coronagraph images and identify limits on 3D geometry and arrival inference.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: v投影=Δr/Δt；真速度取決於運動方向，投影速度不是自動等於朝地球速度。
knowledge.textEn: Projected speed is Δr/Δt;true speed depends on direction and is not automatically the Earth-directed speed.

quiz.question: 「日冕影像尺度」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Coronagraph scale: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付前緣標記、投影速度及到達時間不可唯一決定的說明。
若挑到不同前緣結構，速度可劇變；若亮度擴散不是物質運動，追蹤模型也會失效。
optionsEn: v=580 km/s,is only a two-frame mean plane-of-sky speed.
Deliver front annotations,projected speed and explicit nonuniqueness of arrival time.
Selecting different front structures changes the inferred speed;brightness expansion need not trace identical material.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若挑到不同前緣結構，速度可劇變；若亮度擴散不是物質運動，追蹤模型也會失效。 與本階段判準一起判讀：遮光區未見結構保持未知，不補成靜止前緣。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Selecting different front structures changes the inferred speed;brightness expansion need not trace identical material. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.

steps.title: 日冕影像尺度 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Coronagraph scale · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「日冕影像尺度」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Coronagraph scale and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若挑到不同前緣結構，速度可劇變；若亮度擴散不是物質運動，追蹤模型也會失效。
對照「日冕影像尺度」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。標明投影、取樣間隔與前緣定義；未具三維方向與傳播模型不作精確到達預報。
本階段必須重驗：遮光區未見結構保持未知，不補成靜止前緣。
steps.instructionEn:
Selecting different front structures changes the inferred speed;brightness expansion need not trace identical material.
Against the nominal Coronagraph scale result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. State projection,sampling and front definition;without 3D direction and propagation models,do not issue a precise arrival forecast.
Reverify this criterion: Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若挑到不同前緣結構，速度可劇變；若亮度擴散不是物質運動，追蹤模型也會失效。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Selecting different front structures changes the inferred speed;brightness expansion need not trace identical material.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 遮光區未見結構保持未知，不補成靜止前緣。
steps.checkEn: Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.

options: v投影=Δr/Δt；真速度取決於運動方向，投影速度不是自動等於朝地球速度。

State projection,sampling and front definition;without 3D direction and propagation models,do not issue a precise arrival forecast. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.

steps.title: 日冕影像尺度 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Coronagraph scale · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「日冕影像尺度」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Coronagraph scale and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付前緣標記、投影速度及到達時間不可唯一決定的說明。
在交接件中加入「日冕影像尺度」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：遮光區未見結構保持未知，不補成靜止前緣。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：從合成日冕影像估算平面投影速度，辨識三維幾何與到達時間推論限制。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver front annotations,projected speed and explicit nonuniqueness of arrival time.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Coronagraph scale: Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Estimate plane-of-sky speed from synthetic coronagraph images and identify limits on 3D geometry and arrival inference. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。遮光區未見結構保持未知，不補成靜止前緣。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 遮光區未見結構保持未知，不補成靜止前緣。
steps.checkEn: Unseen structures behind the occulter remain unknown.
